name: codex-fanout
title_zh: 并行跑 codex 的隔离工头：杂活分出去
tagline_zh: 任务裂成独立小块、不需要你判断时，它派无头 codex 进隔离 worktree 干活，你只审结果。
tagline_en: When a task splits into independent chunks needing no judgment, it dispatches headless codex into isolated.
desc_en: Use when a task splits into independent chunks that need a capable model but not your judgement, so the coordinator can fan the work out to headless `codex exec` workers in isolated Git worktrees and review the results.
why_zh: 不是简单调 API，是每个 worker 自带干净 worktree，互不踩踏；协调者只做分派和汇总。
why_en: Not a thin API wrapper—each worker gets a pristine worktree, zero cross-contamination; coordinator only splits and merges.
limit_zh: 只认能拆成无依赖子任务的活；子任务间有共享状态或需要你中途拍板就罢工。产物是合并后的 diff，不负责跑测试。
limit_en: Only for independent sub-tasks with no shared state or mid-flight judgment calls. Output is a merged diff—no test running, conflict fixing, or.
title_en: Parallel codex foreman: fan out chores, collect results
